title: The bench, the crow, the pup
logline: August 2026: the seawall bench empty, the crow on the wall, the pup under the bench in the shade, and no man — he's in the water, at the edge of the page, boots off, cuffs rolled, from behind. Once.

panels.composition: A seawall bench empty in August with a crow on the wall and an old three-legged dog lying in its shade, and at the page's edge below the wall a man in plaid from behind standing in the bay's shallows with his cuffs rolled and boots on the sand.
